Gets all configured App Protection profiles for the specified customer.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/inspectionProfile

Gets all configured App Protection profiles for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20

403

OK

Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
currentCount
int64

The current count of resources per the search feature.

list
InspectionProfile[]
totalCount
int64

The total count of resources per the search feature.

totalPages
int32

The total number of pages per the pagination attribute.
